comment: Forward grouped-convolution instances registered for gfx1250.
One record per AOT instance, in priority order: when several instances can
run a request, the dispatcher picks the first one listed. A record spells
the instance's KernelIdentity fields that leave its family's baseline
(kernels/conv/kernel_label.py) or the defaults below; its name is the
identity's lossless label. Every instance is a shape-generic AOT binary.
The order is fitted to gfx1250 timings of every instance on 2007 forward
convolution graphs: each record sits where the first instance listed for a
graph runs closest to that graph's fastest one. instance_list.py add puts
a new instance last, at the lowest priority; move it to where it belongs.
